The '''CRSF27 space freighter''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufactured on [[Nox (planet)|Nox]] by [[Craedos Shipyards]]. The sturdy and reliable ships were used on many settled [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], in roles varying from [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] to [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. They were capable of interplanetary travel, as well as being a tested [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] vessel.
